Message:
style(Maintain): Alphabetise imports in Eliminator.rs and Substitutor.rs

Reformat import statements in both atomised Inline submodule files to use alphabetical ordering consistent with project conventions.

Eliminator.rs: Flatten `syn` import from double-brace to single-namespace form and reorder super-import items (FindSubstSite before Safe).
Substitutor.rs: Expand single-line super-import into multi-line block with alphabetically sorted identifiers.

No behavioural changes — pure style alignment.
